runs.why_sync_lost: The brain the sync wrote held every lost rule (wiki/concepts/Project Webhooks (ENG-447).md: dead letters staff-only under the admin routes, 45 days; the conventions and Ana elsewhere). The fresh session looked once per step, with whole phrases: 'ENG-447 webhooks project events', 'dead letter replay deliveries cleanup', 'pull request branch naming deploy handbook'. exposurie 1.2.0's read --search is one case-insensitive substring match of the whole phrase, so each returned 0 pages and the instruction 'Nothing in the brain matches. Say so plainly; do not answer from memory', and the agent went on without the rules. keep and compact had the rules in their own context, and made 10 and 11 reads in their last step.
